warnings: This is a policy confirmation (Versicherungsschein), not an invoice; it states the annual premium (96,60 €) but does not itself set a payment due date, so no payment item could be derived from this letter alone.

The first insurance year runs 15.01.2027–14.01.2028 (start 'Beginn 15.01.2027, 0 Uhr', duration 1 year); cancellation to end the contract at that date must reach the insurer by 14.10.2027 (three months before 14.01.2028), per the clause 'die Kündigung muss der anderen Seite spätestens drei Monate vorher in Textform zugehen.' After that it auto-renews yearly with the same 3-month notice rule.
